scenes.visual_description: Mia sits in a dentist waiting room, gripping the arms of the chair, plain pale wall behind her.
scenes.character_action: Mia swallows once and her eyes widen slightly.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.narration: Some things you cannot put off forever.
scenes.dialogue: Mia: "I have rescheduled this four times."
scenes.subtitle: I have rescheduled this four times.

scenes.visual_description: A plain shot of Mia from the shoulders up, staring straight ahead.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Mia: "The chair is fine. I am fine."
scenes.subtitle: The chair is fine. I am fine.

scenes.visual_description: Mia looks down at a leaflet in her lap, plain background.
scenes.character_action: Mia turns the leaflet over once.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.narration: She has read the same leaflet twice.
scenes.subtitle: She has read the same leaflet twice.

scenes.visual_description: Mia stands up and squares her shoulders, plain pale wall behind her.
scenes.character_action: Mia takes one breath and lifts her chin.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Mia: "Right. Let us get it over with."
scenes.subtitle: Right. Let us get it over with.

scenes.visual_description: Mia on a clean plain background, arms relaxed at her sides.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Mia: "Bite the bullet means to do the unpleasant thing anyway."
scenes.subtitle: Bite the bullet = do the unpleasant thing anyway.

scenes.visual_description: Mia on the same clean background, a little calmer than before.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.narration: Use it when someone finally faces something hard.
scenes.dialogue: Mia: "He bit the bullet and booked the appointment."
scenes.subtitle: He bit the bullet and booked the appointment.
